description: INTERACTIVE HUMAN MODE ONLY (autonomous agents must never call this tool). After a human finishes validating at review_url and clicks 'Redact' (where they can also click 'Open redacted PDF' directly in the browser), call this tool with doc_id to get a temporary download_url for the masked PDF and immediately delete the document from the processing server.

doc_id.description: The doc_id returned by propose_masking when status was 'awaiting_review'.
